candidates.prompt: Create ONE exact SIX-FRAME side-view animation pose sheet in a THREE-COLUMNS by TWO-ROWS grid, 1536x1024 landscape, equal 512x512 cells, no borders or labels. Fully transparent background, no scenery, no text, no floor or cast shadow. Reference image 1 is CURRENT FIRE LAEMA IDLE, reference image 2 is CURRENT FIRE SWORD-AND-SHIELD ATTACK STANCE. THESE ARE THE ONLY WEAPON AND OUTFIT AUTHORITY. Match the refined low-resolution modeled-volume shaded sprite appearance, not anime or cartoon. SAME adult Laema all frames: long silver-white ponytail, cream rolled sleeves, open short blue vest, red waist sash, dark brown trousers, brown boots, brown gloves. Always facing RIGHT. She holds a plain straight SILVER SWORD in her RIGHT hand and ONE small round NAVY-BLUE SHIELD on her LEFT forearm/hand, with silver rim and central steel boss. Maintain coherent sword crossguard, shield strap/grip and both hands. Never use hammer, lance, scabbard, magical shield wall, staff or any other weapon. No blue magical effects; shield remains naturally navy cloth/metal color. Blade remains plain silver with no new ornament. Only one tiny RED-ORANGE contact spark in frame 4 marks a Fire parry. All six poses DIFFERENT successive phases of ONE brief parry, NOT a sustained block or counterattack. Same character scale, same centered foot-root, feet at y88% of every cell, all body/weapon parts fully within cell with 10% margins. Body silhouette no more than70% cell height, enough headroom for high shield. Frame 1 and6 identical neutral sword-and-shield ready stance, lightly bent knees, shield chest height and sword angled forward-up. No opponent or incoming weapon. Clear exact six cells, read top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. CANDIDATE 1 SHIELD CATCH. 1 ready; 2 left elbow folds bringing shield close to left upper chest, right sword hand remains stable near hip; 3 shield rotates so its broad face covers forward-right upper torso, chin behind its upper rim; 4 SHORT controlled outward tilt of shield at imagined contact, tiny warm spark at OUTER SHIELD RIM, sword still ready but no strike; 5 retract shield and settle shoulders; 6 exactly ready. Show a quick deflection with left forearm, not an offensive shield bash: shield does not thrust far beyond ready reach and feet do not advance.
